Olivia Brew is a colonel of the UFS.



Personality
She is normally very cold and filled with regret cause of her past sins. Even in harsh situations, she is able to remain calm and collected. Refusing to show weakness or shame, most of the time.

Olivia can break into fits of rage if her past is mentioned or her guilt, and wants to see Edwin Black brought down.

When, she found her team mind broken as slaves, she was driven and pushed mad and killed them, her mind has been since messed up, and she desired to die until talking to Kotaro.

Appearance
She has long white hair and green eyes, her arms have been replaced by mechanical arms, and her body constantly produces Miasma.

History
Background
Olivia is a colonel in the UFS, tasked with missions of elimination at times. Some of her former female only troop, were superb fighters and were never recovered, lost in the hands of Nomad and were forced to choose between death or prostitution.

However, Olivia instead tried to attack Black but was jumped by Ingrid and the others. She was captured by Nomad and modified by Edwin Black. As black had interest, she became a guinea pig for experiments with miasma. A team of UFS soldiers rescued her, but as the commander, she felt guilt and collected information to rescue her team. Arriving at the House of Greed 3 years before TABA, year 2079. Her friends were about to be auctioned off but seeing them broken fully drove Olivia to madness, and she killed everybody. Her mind became clouded, and she returned to the UFS somehow. Unable to kill herself, because of the changed body, she lost her memory over the guilt.

What she experienced is automatically leaking to the Nomad side, but the UFS is not aware of it yet.

Timeline TABA
She returned 3 years later, year 2082, and tried to find her team in Yomihara after a resting period, having been traumatized by the experience, having lost her arms and even her hair losing color.

Causing enough chaos to get the attention of Folia, which agreed to help her, Alberta informed her about the events of the House of Greed, but this only resulted in her memories returning and her going out of control. Kotaro, Alberta and Folia knocked her back to her senses and Kotaro convinced her to live for her team. A follow-up scene reveals that Black was able to spy through her Cyborg arms, and learned more about Kotaro.

As a member of the DSO, she and Donna Burroughs went on a mission to free Nimier. However, in the end agreed that Fuuma Kotaro could keep her for now.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Mechanical Arms

Demonic Miasma: Can control the Miasma from her hands with her mind. Can create semi-solid objects from the Miasma, like a blade. Her arms, mysteriously, have no substance; instead, they are filled with miasma from the demon world, which connects with her bones, nerves, and muscles, giving her immense strength. Depending on her will, she can transform the miasma that spills out from the gaps in her armor into weapons or shields.
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Trivia
Some websites translate her name to Olivia Blue.
In Taimanin Collection Battle Arena, her name is Olivia Brew. Olivia Belew in TABA.
Her ability does not come from her mechanical arms.
She and Viera, share some traits.
The names of her squad team members were, Emily, Liza, Charlotte, Jennifer, Liza and Clara. It is unknown if Emily could be AT Emily Simmons.
